device_timer.title: Add a ventilation timer
device_timer.description: Pick the Inovelli switch to run as a paddle-driven ventilation timer.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single grouping controller is allowed.

data_description.window_seconds: How long a switch stays in pairing mode after you hold its config button.
data_description.palette: Hues cycled by a single tap while pairing. Orange (21) is reserved for ungrouped switches.
data_description.pair_prefix: Zigbee groups created by pairing are named like "Inovelli Link 1".
data_description.cmd_arm: ZHA event command that arms pairing / adds a switch (default button_3_hold).
data_description.cmd_color: ZHA event command that cycles the group color while pairing (default button_3_press).
data_description.cmd_remove: ZHA event command that removes a switch from its group (default button_3_double).
data_description.cmd_exit: ZHA event command(s) that exit pairing early; pick one or more (default down/up paddle single tap).
data_description.default_light_hue: LED bar hue a light dimmer shows when it is not in a group (default 21, orange).
data_description.default_fan_hue: LED bar hue a fan switch shows when it is not in a group (default 170, blue).
data_description.enable_hardware: React to the physical scene buttons (hold to pair/arm, tap to set color, etc.). Turn off for a dashboard-only setup.
data_description.enable_dashboard: Adds a "Paddleforge Controller" sidebar panel + Lovelace card to create, add, recolor, and remove groups. Hard-refresh the browser after toggling.
data_description.hide_group_entities: ZHA auto-creates a light + switch entity for every Zigbee group; they duplicate the bound switches and leak to HomeKit/Google. On (default) disables them in the entity registry; off re-enables the ones this integration disabled.
data_description.max_minutes: The most time the timer can be set to (paddle-hold and double-tap both cap here).
data_description.double_tap_minutes: Time a double-tap start loads (defaults to the maximum).
data_description.hold_ramp_seconds_full: Seconds of paddle-hold to sweep from empty to the maximum.
data_description.led_refresh_interval: How often the LED bar is repainted while counting down.
data_description.led_color_hue: Fill color for a manually-started (paddle) timer (default 170, blue).
data_description.auto_led_color_hue: Fill color for a humidity/automation-started run, so you can tell it apart at a glance (default 127, teal).
data_description.pulse_hue: Color of the breathing segment at the top of the fill, marking the counting edge (default 255, white).
data_description.flash_threshold_seconds: When the remaining time drops below this, the bar fast-blinks.
data_description.cmd_start: ZHA event command that starts the timer (default up-paddle double tap).
data_description.cmd_up_hold: ZHA event command that raises the time while held (default up-paddle hold).
data_description.cmd_up_release: ZHA event command that locks the raised time (default up-paddle release).
data_description.cmd_down_hold: ZHA event command that lowers the time while held (default down-paddle hold).
data_description.cmd_down_release: ZHA event command that locks the lowered time (default down-paddle release).
